note: Gate D W2 — D03 (Player Detail Development/AI hypothesis) and D06 (Player intelligence, cross-source hypothesis), deferred from Wave 1 (PR #844, merged/approved 2026-11-25). Seven candidates total: three D03 states (grounded longitudinal hypothesis, sparse no-hypothesis, coach decision flow), four D06 states (coherent synthesis, genuine contradiction, sparse cross-source, source inspection + confirmation). Every interactive candidate reuses the real, unmodified AssistantCoachHypothesisPanel via a new fixture-safe actions override mount (AssistantCoachHypothesisMount), following the exact Gate C W3 C07 RSC-boundary pattern. EvidenceSourceInspector (source-linking) and NoDefensibleHypothesis (honest insufficiency state) are new, explicitly disclosed directional presentations — no equivalent exists in production today (see CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md); both disclosed production gaps are filed as GitHub issues #845 and #846 rather than fixed in this UI-Lab-only wave. No production code changed anywhere in this wave. scripts/ui-lab-visual-review.mjs registers all seven routes for CI capture. capture-attestation.json is not yet included; it requires a real CI capture run. All candidates are CANDIDATE, pending owner review — none approved, none merged, none self-approved. The `assistantCoachState` field below uses descriptive values (ACTIVE / EMPTY) consistent with this field's apparent intent in Wave 1's manifest, since every Wave 1 entry used NOT_APPLICABLE (none of Wave 1's scenarios involved Assistant Coach) and no other value was ever established — disclosed here rather than silently copied from an inapplicable precedent. REMEDIATION (independent review, same PR): GATE-D-W2-D06-COHERENT and GATE-D-W2-D06-SOURCE-INSPECTION's hypothesis statements reworded the awkward bare-code parenthetical ('(profile role: F)' reading oddly beside 'centre forward' in prose) into a clearer 'in 14-role profile terms, from profile role: X to profile role: Y' construction; fixtureVersion bumped to 2 on both (derivation and test coverage unchanged). docs/ui-lab/gate-d-w2-candidates/REVIEW_RECORD.md records the full independent-review findings and disposition.
